Rolling service

Which Lovable Build mode runtime is identified?

Current publisher documentation names Build mode and identifies Agent mode as its former name; the dated Agent-mode transition and model milestone do not identify the current service revision.

Service · Release Milestone

Lovable's changelog says Agent mode became the default mode on 2025-08-11 and that the prior non-agent legacy mode was scheduled to sunset on 2025-09-01.

Project changes

What does Build mode change?

Current docs distinguish non-writing Plan mode from Build mode that applies multi-file changes and exposes diffs and summaries.

Workspace · Agent Execution

Current Lovable documentation says Build mode explores project code, applies coordinated changes across files, can inspect logs and network activity, fetch external documentation or assets, and exposes its work through tasks, diffs and summaries.

Concurrency

Where can work run in parallel?

The main Build-mode prompt queue processes one task at a time, while temporary read-only subagents may perform separate investigations in parallel and report findings to the main agent.

Execution · Queue Limitation

Current Lovable documentation says Build mode processes one main task at a time while additional prompts enter a visible, reorderable and pausable queue, including a repeat control for queued prompts.

Execution · Parallel Subagents

Current Lovable documentation says the main agent can start temporary read-only subagents for research, code exploration and review, can run several independent subagents in parallel, and receives their findings before deciding what to do next; subagents cannot change the project and Lovable decides when to use them.

Cloud authority

Which backend actions and region apply?

Cloud tools can be always allowed, asked each time or denied, and new projects can use several regions.

Approval · Cloud Tools

Current Lovable Cloud documentation separates disabled and enabled Cloud projects, gives Cloud tools Always allow, Ask each time or Never allow policies, and lets new Cloud projects use closest, Americas, Europe or Asia Pacific region selection.

Repository and publish output

Where do changes go?

A connected GitHub App can sync the linked repository, while a live deployment requires an explicit Publish or Update action.

Repository · Github Sync

Current Lovable documentation says an owner or admin can authorize OAuth, install the Lovable GitHub App for all or selected repositories, connect one project to one repository, and enable two-way synchronization on the default branch.

Record limitations

  • All service claims are attributed to Lovable public sources; no service behavior was observed.
  • No account, project, Cloud environment, repository connection, browser test or deployment was created or run.
  • Dated changelog milestones do not freeze current prompts, tools, models, infrastructure or policy.
  • Plan, Build, serial main-task queue, read-only subagent, verification, Cloud, GitHub and publish paths are separately scoped.
  • Parallel subagent evidence applies only to temporary read-only investigations; it does not support parallel project-writing agents.
  • GitHub synchronization is distinct from Lovable's own publish action and neither is inferred to have occurred.
  • No independent evaluation was admitted.
  • No capability quality, safety, privacy, performance or suitability conclusion is supported.
